records.source: Gunther can tell you more about this if you donate it to the museum.

records.source: Welcome to "Livin' Off The Land". We're back again with another tip for y'all. Now listen up:
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa "Pamumuhay Mula sa Lupa". Nagbalik kami na may panibagong payo para sa inyong lahat. Makinig kayo:

records.source: Greetings! It is I, the queen of sauce... here to teach you a new mouth-watering recipe from my secret cookbook. This week's dish...
records.translation: Pagbati! Ako ito, ang Reyna ng Sarsa... narito upang turuan ka ng bagong nakatatakam na resipe mula sa lihim kong aklat-lutuin. Ang putahe sa linggong ito...

records.source: Ah... I sense that a new viewer has joined us. A young man from... Stardew Valley? Welcome, welcome!
records.translation: Ah... Nadarama kong may bagong manonood na sumama sa atin. Isang binata mula sa... Stardew Valley? Maligayang pagdating!

records.source: Ah... I sense that a new viewer has joined us. A young lady from... Stardew Valley? Welcome, welcome!
records.translation: Ah... Nadarama kong may bagong manonood na sumama sa atin. Isang dalaga mula sa... Stardew Valley? Maligayang pagdating!

records.source: Ah... yes, I can hear the spirits whispering something to me...
records.translation: Ah... oo, naririnig kong may ibinubulong sa akin ang mga espiritu...

records.source: Welcome back to 'Welwick's Oracle'... If you seek hidden knowledge of the future, well you've come to the right place.
records.translation: Maligayang pagbabalik sa 'Orakulo ni Welwick'... Kung naghahanap ka ng nakatagong kaalaman tungkol sa hinaharap, nasa tamang lugar ka.

records.source: Hoo.. I see a glimmer within my scrying orb... A shard of knowledge from the future!
records.translation: Hoo.. May nakikita akong kislap sa loob ng bolang panghula ko... Isang piraso ng kaalaman mula sa hinaharap!

records.source: Welcome to Welwick's Oracle... the ONLY show where the voice of the spirits is channeled directly... to YOU.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Orakulo ni Welwick... ang TANGING palabas kung saan tuwirang ipinadadaloy ang tinig ng mga espiritu... sa IYO.

records.source: Welcome to KOZU 5... your number one source for weather, news, and entertainment.^And now, the weather forecast for tomorrow...
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa KOZU 5... ang pangunahin mong mapagkukunan ng lagay ng panahon, balita, at libangan.^At ngayon, ang taya ng panahon para bukas...

records.source: Just kidding... I'm not ready. I don't have anything for you today.
records.translation: Nagbibiro lang... Hindi ako handa. Wala akong maibibigay sa iyo ngayon.

records.source: You already know how to cook {0}.
records.translation: Marunong ka nang magluto ng {0}.

records.source: You learned how to cook '{0}'!
records.translation: Natutuhan mong magluto ng '{0}'!

records.source: Um... that's odd. My information sheet just says 'null'. This is embarrassing...
records.translation: Um... kakaiba iyon. 'null' lang ang nakasulat sa talaan ng impormasyon ko. Nakakahiya ito...
records.englishResidueReason: null is an intentional programming-value joke displayed verbatim in the source dialogue.

records.source: It's going to be clear and sunny tomorrow... perfect weather for the {0}! The event will take place {1}, starting between {2} and {3}. Don't be late!
records.translation: Magiging maaliwalas at maaraw bukas... perpektong panahon para sa {0}! Gaganapin ang kaganapan {1}, at magsisimula sa pagitan ng {2} at {3}. Huwag mahuli!

records.source: Bundle up, folks. It's going to snow tomorrow!
records.translation: Magbihis nang makapal, mga kaibigan. Uulan ng niyebe bukas!

records.source: Expect a few inches of snow tomorrow.
records.translation: Asahan ang ilang pulgada ng niyebe bukas.

records.source: It's going to be a beautiful, sunny day tomorrow!
records.translation: Magiging maganda at maaraw ang araw bukas!

records.source: It's going to be clear and sunny all day.
records.translation: Magiging maaliwalas at maaraw sa buong araw.

records.source: It's going to rain all day tomorrow.
records.translation: Uulan sa buong araw bukas.

records.source: Looks like a storm is approaching. Thunder and lightning is expected.
records.translation: Mukhang may paparating na bagyo. Asahan ang kulog at kidlat.

records.source: Partially cloudy with a light breeze. Expect lots of pollen!
records.translation: Bahagyang maulap at may banayad na simoy. Asahan ang maraming polen!

records.source: It's going to be cloudy, with gusts of wind throughout the day.
records.translation: Magiging maulap, na may malalakas na bugso ng hangin sa buong araw.

records.source: It's going to snow all day. Make sure you bundle up, folks!
records.translation: Uulan ng niyebe sa buong araw. Tiyaking magbihis nang makapal, mga kaibigan!

records.source: The spirits are furious. Apparently someone tried to give them a worthless offering... Hmm. It's unwise to play jokes on the spirits!
records.translation: Galit na galit ang mga espiritu. Tila may nagtangkang magbigay sa kanila ng walang-kuwentang handog... Hmm. Hindi matalinong biruin ang mga espiritu!
